paper.title: Statsmodels: Econometric and Statistical Modeling with Python
paper.reference: Seabold and Perktold, Proceedings of the 9th Python in Science Conference (2010)

paper_context.research_question: Does the released Statsmodels OLS implementation reproduce the deterministic Longley regression fit?
paper_context.method: Fit OLS with an intercept to the package-distributed Longley macroeconomic dataset.
paper_context.data_and_splits: Longley dataset distributed with Statsmodels; 16 public macroeconomic observations.
paper_context.evaluation_protocol: Run once and extract R-squared from JSON stdout.
paper_context.limitations: A certified small econometric fit, not every model family described by the software paper.

claims.protocol: Run once and extract R-squared from JSON stdout.
